matched_quality_depth_control.GATE_0_HEADLINE_FINDING: THE REQUESTED CONTROL IS DEGENERATE BY CONSTRUCTION. train_qcmem_distill.py defines TEACHER = QCMem read at j=0 (adapters disabled, no_grad) and STUDENT = QCMem read at j=resume_j (adapters on). At resume_j=0 these are the SAME path -- same pack, same depth, same RoPE, same mask -- differing ONLY by a zero-init LoRA delta, so teacher==student and the top-64 KL is identically 0 at init. MEASURED (not argued): a 1-GPU 20-step probe of the flagship recipe with ONLY resume_j 12->0 gives loss 0.0000 at step 1 and ~0.0015 thereafter, vs the flagship j=12's 0.2991 at step 10; the full 8-GPU arm holds ~0.001-0.002 (max 0.0077) through step 580. The trainer's own docstring states the same: 'at --resume_j 0 teacher==student by construction'.
matched_quality_depth_control.CONSEQUENCE_the_defect_dissolves: A 'LoRA distilled for j=0' under this recipe is not a matched-quality j=0 adapter, it is a NULL adapter whose optimum is the identity == the base model. That arm is ALREADY on disk as the dvr arm j0_top12 (ruler_results/a02_dvr_ruler_j0_top12, verified config resume_j=0 selector=iter_bm25 topk=12 iter_hop_topk=4 lora_adapter=None baseline=none seed=42). Hence depth_vs_retrieval's read_deployed step (j0_top12 -> c2_comem, -3 to -12pp on RULER) ALREADY IS the matched-quality depth contrast: each depth carries the adapter its own distillation objective optimally supplies (identity for j=0, the 58.20M flagship for j=12). A02_DEPTH_VS_RETRIEVAL_VERDICT.md 7.1's claim that no arm isolates depth with a matched-quality adapter is OVER-PESSIMISTIC and should be restated.
matched_quality_depth_control.second_order_effect_being_measured: At q==p both the KL and its gradient are exactly zero, but in bf16 the two paths are numerically distinguishable, so gradients are tiny-but-nonzero. AdamW normalises by sqrt(v) and is SCALE-INVARIANT, so arbitrarily small noise gradients still produce full lr-sized updates. Over 4000 steps at lr 8e-5 the j=0 control adapter is predicted to become an Adam-amplified random walk on bf16 noise -- plausibly WORSE than base, certainly not better. Running to completion so this is measured rather than asserted.

matched_quality_depth_control.what_is_matched: backbone (Qwen--Qwen3-8b, NOT Qwen3-8B-Base -- the flagship adapter's base_model_name_or_path and every phase-1/dvr arm used Qwen--Qwen3-8b); teacher (j=0 adapters-off no-grad); data + order + token count (PG19, seed 42, ws 8, n_ctx 3 -> 65.5M tok/arm; pg19_train.jsonl is 11450766349 B with md5(first 100MB)=ed2868281b1dc815dc96e2f3592cccbe and md5(last 100MB)=bec4b5f244b85f1dbd66cd9054058630 IDENTICAL on wzc1 and zwfy6, and PG19Packer shards deterministically by wcount%world_size); LR schedule (8e-5, warmup 100, cosine, AdamW betas 0.9/0.95, wd 0, clip 1.0); seq_len/eff batch (2048-tok window, 1 window/rank/step, grad_accum 1 -> 8 windows/step); loss (bidir top-64 KL lam 0.6, ce 0); bf16/sdpa/grad_ckpt off; eval-side retrieval byte-identical (iter_bm25 topk12 iter_hop_topk4 sink bos chunk512, chat_template=False).

matched_quality_depth_control.the_one_unmatched_axis_and_its_control: Adapter capacity is STRUCTURALLY tied to j (span = layers[j:36]): r=32 gives 87.29/72.74/65.47/58.20/43.65M at j=0/6/9/12/18. It cannot be matched at fixed r. It CAN be matched by moving r: 75776*40*24 (j=12,r40) == 75776*32*30 (j=6,r32) == 72,744,960 EXACTLY. That is arm A6, and GATE C asserts the arithmetic fail-closed before launch.

matched_quality_depth_control.training_verification: world_size=8; param groups 87.29M on layers[0:36] matching the architecture formula exactly; monotone step counter with loss + warmup->cosine lr; 41015/97871 MiB = 41.9% per card at 98-100% util on all 8; zero failure syntax (grep filtered with -viE 'No NaN/Inf' so the PASSING no-NaN line cannot cause a false alarm); 9 procs = 1 launcher + 8 ranks.
matched_quality_depth_control.measured_cadence: 1.088 s/step over a REAL 420-step window (step 160->580, 457 s); cross-checked 1.046 (160->290) and 1.107 (290->580). A1 ETA ~73 min; A6 (24 vs 36 grad layers) ~55-62 min; both ~2.1-2.3 h. matched_quality_depth_control.batch_size_reasoning: UNCHANGED and NOT TUNABLE. (1) The trainer has no batch dimension -- no --batch_size flag exists; PG19Packer yields one window per step and write_chunk takes a single [1,T] chunk. (2) The only volume knobs, n_ctx=3 and grad_accum=1, are PART OF THE RECIPE BEING MATCHED; raising them would change tokens/step and the data partition, destroying the matched-tokens property this gate exists to establish. Per-rank memory is a FULL REPLICA (the trainer deliberately avoids DDP because QCMem calls layers[i] directly, and does explicit all_reduce instead), so per CLAUDE.md adding cards does not reduce per-card memory: ~16.4 GB frozen bf16 backbone + 0.17 grads + 0.35 AdamW on LoRA only = ~17.1 GB static, ~41.9 GB observed. Filling the card would INVALIDATE the experiment; 41.9% occupancy is the correct outcome, not an under-utilisation.
matched_quality_depth_control.no_eval_interval_flag: This trainer HAS NO --eval_interval flag and NO inline eval in its step loop (verified by grep; only a docstring mention of run_self_test). The NCCL-watchdog SIGABRT mode therefore cannot occur, and passing --eval_interval 0 would be a bogus arg that argparse would REJECT and kill the launch -- exactly how a probe died on --keep_last_n (the zwfy6 trainer predates the rotation args). All eval is offline on saved adapters.
matched_quality_depth_control.readout_planned: PRIMARY: RULER niah_multikey_1 + variable_tracking x {16k,32k}, n=100/cell, 8 shards -- the retrieval-CLOSED benchmark (dvr recall@12 = 99-100%), so depth cannot be confounded by retrieval. Paired per-cell delta vs A0 = the read tax at depth j. SECONDARY: BABILong qa1/qa2/qa5 x {16k,32k} for contrast ONLY -- dvr established those cells are retrieval-dominated (54.9-78.6%, recall@12 22.9-63.2%) and CANNOT support depth inference. Per-cell only; no pooled BABILong/LongEval figure will be computed or quoted.

matched_quality_depth_control.what_it_WILL_license: Retiring next_gate[3] by DEMONSTRATION rather than assertion; restating verdict 7.1 (read_deployed already IS the matched-quality depth contrast); a 5-point depth-tax curve (j=0/6/9/12/18) with retrieval held byte-identical and the distillation recipe fixed -- the first such curve on a retrieval-closed benchmark; and whether that curve survives EXACT capacity matching.
matched_quality_depth_control.what_it_will_NOT_license: Nothing here revives A02's thesis. Storage stays DEAD (2048x raw text); read-compute stays a 1.03-1.37x micro-optimisation. EVERY number this gate can produce is a TAX (an accuracy cost of the depth knob), so NO outcome can be a quality win. It does NOT license: any 'CoMem beats RAG on quality' claim; reading j12_frozen's -97pp as a depth effect (that remains 'untrained depth-12 resume is non-functional'); any BABILong-based depth claim (retrieval-dominated); any cross-model/cross-family claim (Qwen3-8B only, one seed 42, H20/bf16/sdpa); any claim of capacity matching ACROSS the ladder (only A6-vs-A4 is matched).
matched_quality_depth_control.is_this_in_the_benefits_text_RAG_identic: NO. STATUS flags that trap for the two other candidate directions (sublinear retrieval, better selector), and it is a real trap. Plain text-RAG has no depth knob -- it always reads at full depth -- so the depth axis IS specific to mid-depth resume. But that only makes the result CoMem-SPECIFIC, not GOOD: this gate prices a knob, it does not find a win, and it does not change A02's promotion status.

status_long: Original PROPOSAL.md thesis is DEAD: no protocol-clean benchmark shows C2 significantly better in aggregate, so 'CoMem beats RAG on quality' does not hold. Storage framing is DEAD on arithmetic (h12 8192 B/token vs raw text 4 B/token = 2048x; CoMem-total/RAG-total 632-1129x). What SURVIVES and is worth writing up: (1) the depth-vs-retrieval DIAGNOSTIC protocol -- a 4-arm single-variable chain showing a 4-way-confounded A-vs-B comparison inflated its headline 2-5x; this is publishable as methodology independent of whether CoMem is good; (2) the RULER read tax at corrected magnitude (-10.0/-12.0/-11.0pp SIG with retrieval held byte-identical and recall@12 at 99-100%); (3) a modest read-compute win (1.33x at G=1 decaying to 1.03x at G=128, N* 8-225 queries vs matched-pack text-RAG). ADDED 2026-08-12: (4) the last open confound (no matched-quality depth control) is DEGENERATE BY CONSTRUCTION -- at j=0 the distillation teacher and student are the same path, so the optimal j=0 adapter is the identity and the existing read_deployed step already is the matched contrast; see matched_quality_depth_control.

read_tax_ruler_gate.A1_is_null_in_EFFECT_not_in_WEIGHTS: ||lora_B||_2 = 15.20 vs flagship 15.47, 100% of entries non-zero: 4000 AdamW steps DID write a full-norm update. But max|B| = 1.38e-2 vs flagship 6.52e-2 (4.7x smaller) = a diffuse isotropic perturbation, not concentrated learned structure. Exactly PREREG 1.2's predicted 'Adam-amplified random walk on bf16 noise'. Visible in outputs: A1's generations differ from A0's on 30/32/12/49 of 100 samples per cell, yet ZERO of those differences change correctness - the divergence is confined to post-answer continuation text, the answer span is untouched. This is why the PREREG insisted on running 4000 steps rather than asserting vacuity from the 20-step probe.
